description: Keep an app files in sync with a GitHub repo. The repo becomes the source of truth: editing the app files in Neblla is blocked while linked (edit in the repo and push). Actions: "repos" — the developer GitHub repos (needs "Sign in with GitHub"); "branches" (url) — branches of a repo; "status"; "link" (url, optional branch, subdir, syncMode manual|auto, token only if the developer has not signed in with GitHub) — first sync, and in auto mode the push webhook is registered automatically when GitHub is linked; "sync" — pull now (only changed files are downloaded); "set_mode" manual|auto; "test_branch" (branch, or null to remove) — a private copy <appId>_test with the same settings that follows another branch, never in the gallery; "unlink". Each pull costs quota credits.

appId.description: The app public ID (not needed for "repos" / "branches")

branch.description: For link: live branch (default: the repo default); for test_branch: the test branch, null removes it

subdir.description: For link: folder inside the repo that holds the app (default "dist"; "" = repo root)

token.description: For link: GitHub token, only if the developer has not signed in with GitHub (stored encrypted, never returned)

name: neblla_git
